svg.title: Blueprint sheet 20, the one roof: too small alone, so the village owns one co-op that runs them all (after Giovanni Teneggi and the community co-operatives of the Apennines)

g.text: so the village owns one co-op that runs them all
the old saying: l’unione fa la forza. together, we are strong.
shop, a bar and beds to
a living blueprint for a world
